templates.name: homepage
templates.description: College homepage — top-level landing page for the LSA site. Hero, featured news, CTA banners, magazine features.

templates.name: audience-landing
templates.description: Audience/program landing pages (prospective students, transfer, undergraduate). Interior-page shell (breadcrumb + h1 + section-nav dropped as chrome) plus hero banners, image-tile cards, student-profile heroes, and story-tile cards.

templates.name: academics-listing
templates.description: Academics directory pages under /lsa/academics/ — a filterable program/department widget (data-lsa-dept-programs-mode: 'programs' for majors-minors, 'departms' for departments-and-units). Default-content-only: intro rich text + a directory table. No hero/cards/columns blocks. Interior-page shell (breadcrumb + h1 + section-nav) handled by cleanup transformer. Per-row detail is AJAX on the source; migrated as a static directory table.

templates.name: department-landing
templates.description: Department-scoped interior landing pages (e.g. /english/undergraduate, /urop/prospective-students). No full-bleed gridwrapper sections; interior-page shell (breadcrumb + h1 + left section-nav + department footer) dropped as chrome. #page-content holds default content plus (optionally) a four-button promo grid mapped to the cards block (four-button branch). Content seen: four-button grid, pull-quote, text+image welcome, Contact Information (english/undergraduate); YouTube video (iframe→link), intro text, and a stack of full-width CTA buttons (urop/prospective-students). Decorative '. . .' divider tables and raw iframes dropped.

templates.name: unit-home
templates.description: Top-level unit / program home pages (Residential College, CGIS). A stack of full-bleed gridwrapper sections inside #content: a pull-quote hero over a full-bleed unit banner (+ CTA buttons); a mission text column beside an image slideshow with promo tiles (default content); dark image-gallery sections; a Featured News cards block with an Instagram embed; and a support-CTA banner. Reuses existing hero + cards blocks; gallery/mission/CTA sections are default content. Header/footer/audience-nav chrome dropped by cleanup transformer.
